entities.name: Muhammad Shah Rukh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shazada Muhammad Shahrukh was a Pakistani field hockey player and cyclist. He competed in the field hockey event, alongside his brother Muhammad Khurram, at the 1948 Summer Olympics and in four cycling events at the 1956 Summer Olympics.
